{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 (sentinel value)
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# Sort by sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates
df_dedup = df_clean.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 3: Compute mean of biomarker_baseline
mean_baseline = df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print result
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) across all patients: {mean_baseline}')"}
